## Conference Timeline

The BTR conference follows an annual timeline with key milestones:

- **January 24, 2025** – call for paper submissions
- **April 30, 2025** – paper submissions due
- **May-June** – peer review process
- **July** – conference schedule and keynote speakers finalized
- **August 6-7, 2025** – BTR Conference

## Past BTR Conferences

Since its inception in 2018, the Bridging Transportation Researchers (BTR) conference has grown into a significant annual event in the transportation research community. Each conference archive contains presentation recordings, slides, and program details from that year's event.

### Conference Archives

**[BTR 1 (January 2020)](https://bridgingtransport.org/archive-directory/archive-of-btr-1-january-2020/)**
The inaugural BTR conference, establishing the foundation for future virtual transportation research gatherings.

**[BTR 2 (August 2020)](https://bridgingtransport.org/archive-directory/archive-of-btr-2-august-2020/)**
The first conference held in August, setting the annual schedule that continues today.

**[BTR 3 (August 2021)](https://bridgingtransport.org/archive-directory/archive-of-btr-3-august-2021/)**
Continued growth in participation and international reach during the global pandemic.

**[BTR 4 (August 2022)](https://bridgingtransport.org/archive-directory/archive-of-btr-4-august-2022/)**
Expansion of parallel sessions and enhanced technical capabilities.

**[BTR 5 (August 2023)](https://bridgingtransport.org/archive-directory/archive-of-btr-5-august-2023/)**
Introduction of special sessions and increased industry participation.

**[BTR 6 (August 2024)](https://bridgingtransport.org/archive-directory/archive-of-btr-6-august-2024/)**
The most recent completed conference with record attendance and participation.

**[BTR 7 (August 2025)](https://bridgingtransport.org/archive-directory/archive-of-btr-7-august-2025/)**
The upcoming conference featuring new innovations and expanded programming.

## Archive Content

Each conference archive typically includes:

- **Headliner presentations** with slides and recordings
- **Session recordings** organized by track and topic
- **Conference program** with detailed schedules
- **Participant statistics** and demographics
- **Special sessions** and workshops
- **Award announcements** and recognition

## Accessing Archives

All conference archives are freely accessible and provide valuable resources for:

- **Researchers** seeking recent developments in transportation
- **Students** learning about current research trends
- **Practitioners** looking for applied research insights
- **Educators** developing course materials
- **Policy makers** understanding research implications

## Future Archives

BTR continues to grow each year, with plans for:

- Enhanced recording quality and accessibility
- Improved search functionality across archives
- Integration with academic databases
- Mobile-friendly archive interfaces
- Multilingual support for international participants

For questions about accessing archive materials or technical issues, please contact [bridgingtransport@gmail.com](mailto:bridgingtransport@gmail.com).
